newsitem.title: USA: Foster Wheeler Q2 net to have charges, gain.
newsitem.headline: Foster Wheeler Q2 net to have charges, gain.

text.p: Foster Wheeler Corp said Wednesday its second quarter earnings will include both charges and gains.
It said the earnings will include a pretax gain of $57.0 million from the sale of the assets of its subsidiary, Glitsch International Inc, to Koch Engineering Co.

It said the gain will be offset by $60.0 million in charges against its power systems unit on the Robbins Resource Recovery facility and by $32.0 million in charges of Foster Wheeler energy equipment group for closure of its San Diego office and resulting staff relocation and severance costs.
The $32.0 million also includes additional costs following the discontinuauce of certain product lines and writedowns on certain overvalued assets, as well as miscellaneous charges.
In addition, earnings will include a charge of $7.0 million against corporate and financial services for a writedown of overvalued assets.
A final second quarter earnings statement will be released July 29.
